mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eattea_knowledge (term, definition, category, related_terms, source, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{term}, #{definition}, #{category}, #{relatedTerms}, #{source}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM eattea_knowledge ORDER BY category, term

SELECT *, MATCH(term, definition) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) AS relevance FROM eattea_knowledge WHERE MATCH(term, definition) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) ORDER BY relevance DESC LIMIT 50
mapper.update: UPDATE eattea_knowledge SET term = #{term}, definition = #{definition}, category = #{category}, related_terms = #{relatedTerms}, source = #{source}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
